references.title: Towards P != NP from Extended Frege Lower Bounds
references.note: Introduces witnessing formulas whose tautologicity plus lower bounds for an augmented Extended Frege system imply superpolynomial SAT circuit lower bounds.

references.title: On the Proof Complexity of the Nisan-Wigderson Generator Based on a Hard NP intersect coNP Function
references.note: Formulates Extended Frege hardness of Nisan-Wigderson generator tautologies from average-case hardness of an NP intersect coNP function.

references.title: On the Existence of Strong Proof Complexity Generators
references.note: Relates one-bit-stretch generators hitting every infinite NP set to proof-complexity generators hard for all propositional proof systems.

references.title: Extended Frege Proofs, Circuits and Rewriting
references.note: Shows that short Extended Frege proofs of circuit equivalence induce polynomial-length chains under a polynomial-time local circuit-rewriting relation.

references.title: Disjoint NP-Pairs from Propositional Proof Systems
references.note: Develops canonical disjoint NP pairs associated with propositional proof systems and their structural relation to proof strength.

references.title: Circuit Complexity, Proof Complexity, and Polynomial Identity Testing
references.note: Introduces IPS, connects IPS lower bounds to algebraic circuit lower bounds, and formulates PIT-axiom routes to bounded-depth Frege lower bounds.

references.title: Polynomial Identity Testing and the Ideal Proof System
references.note: Proves that PIT is in NP exactly when IPS can be polynomially simulated by a deterministically verifiable Cook-Reckhow proof system, even for Boolean unsatisfiability.

references.title: Derandomizing Polynomial Identity Tests Means Proving Circuit Lower Bounds
references.note: Shows that sufficiently strong PIT derandomization yields major Boolean or arithmetic circuit lower bounds.

references.title: Knowledge Compilation, Width and Quantification
references.note: Connects bounded structural width, deterministic knowledge compilation, and quantified projection; supplies both algorithmic tools and lower-bound targets.

references.title: A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas
references.note: Provides explicit polynomial-size CNFs requiring strongly exponential DNNF size, enabling representation-transfer attacks.

references.title: A Short Proof that the Extension Complexity of the Correlation Polytope Grows Exponentially
references.note: Gives an explicit exponential linear extension-complexity lower bound relevant to exact local lift grammars.

references.title: Lower Bounds on the Size of Semidefinite Programming Relaxations
references.note: Establishes superpolynomial SDP extension-complexity lower bounds and constrains exact constant-level semidefinite lift routes.

references.title: Lower Bounds for Polynomial Calculus with Extension Variables over Finite Fields
references.note: Proves finite-field lower bounds for extension-variable polynomial calculus under support restrictions, defining a central normalization target.

references.title: Self-Improvement for Circuit-Analysis Problems
references.note: Shows that modest improvements for Circuit-SAT and related analysis problems can bootstrap to much stronger algorithms and lower-bound consequences.

references.title: Range Avoidance and Remote Point for Low-Depth Circuits: New Algorithms and Hardness
references.note: Develops algorithms and hardness connections for range avoidance, a key route from total search to explicit circuit lower bounds.

references.title: Near-Maximum Circuit Lower Bounds for Exponential Time with Merlin-Arthur Queries
references.note: Combines range avoidance, iterative win-win arguments, and PCP methods to obtain near-maximum circuit lower bounds for an exponential-time class.

references.title: A Note on Natural-Proofs for Super-Linear Lower Bounds for Linear Functions
references.note: Extends the natural-proofs barrier to explicit linear functions and motivates sparse or otherwise non-natural lower-bound properties.

references.title: Conditional Complexity Hardness: Monotone Circuit Size, Matrix Rigidity, and Tensor Rank Under NSETH and Beyond
references.note: Builds conditional generators of hard functions, rigid matrices, and high-rank tensors, illustrating win-win paths around direct lower-bound barriers.

references.title: Hard CNF Instances for Ideal Proof Systems
references.note: Proves CNF lower bounds for roABP-IPS and isolates unrestricted full-IPS lower bounds for Boolean CNFs as a central frontier.

references.title: A Lower Bound for k-DNF Resolution on Random CNF Formulas via Expansion
references.note: Provides expansion-based lower bounds for stronger resolution systems on random CNFs, motivating explicit mixed residual and clause-learning obstructions.

references.title: Super-Quadratic Lower Bounds for Depth-2 Linear Threshold Circuits
references.note: Uses a nontrivial circuit-analysis algorithm to derive a new threshold-circuit lower bound, demonstrating the algorithmic method at a current frontier.

claim_boundary: Primary sources establish implications, attack boundaries, and current frontiers only. They do not certify JANUS novelty or truth.
